pvpocket.rule.group.d.hint: What you bring in and pick up
pvpocket.rule.a.series.label: Series
pvpocket.rule.a.series.hint: The first side to win (rounds ÷ 2 + 1) takes the series. Items and terrain are restored after every round.
pvpocket.rule.a.roundLimit.label: Round time limit
pvpocket.rule.a.roundLimit.hint: After this the round is settled by the timeout rule. Unlimited when off.
pvpocket.rule.a.timeoutVerdict.label: Timeout verdict
pvpocket.rule.a.timeoutVerdict.hint: How a round is decided when the clock runs out.
pvpocket.rule.a.countdown.label: Preparation time
pvpocket.rule.a.countdown.hint: Time between being teleported in and the first blow, counted down in chat one second at a time. Nobody can deal or take damage during it, and a solid white wall stands around the plot until the round goes live.
pvpocket.rule.a.intermission.label: Intermission
pvpocket.rule.a.intermission.hint: The break between two rounds of a series.
pvpocket.rule.a.winConditions.label: Win conditions
pvpocket.rule.a.winConditions.hint: Which events can end a round. Keep at least one.
pvpocket.rule.b.teamCount.label: Teams
pvpocket.rule.b.teamCount.hint: How many sides fight. 2 is the classic 1v1 / 2v2.
pvpocket.rule.b.teamSize.label: Players per team
pvpocket.rule.b.teamSize.hint: Players on each side. Total = teams × players per team.
pvpocket.rule.b.maxPlayers.label: Player cap
pvpocket.rule.b.maxPlayers.hint: The duel cannot start above this many players.
pvpocket.rule.b.friendlyFire.label: Friendly fire
pvpocket.rule.b.friendlyFire.hint: When on, teammates can damage each other.
pvpocket.rule.b.spectator.label: Allow spectating
pvpocket.rule.b.spectator.hint: When on, anyone not in the duel can see it in /pvpocket list and press Watch to enter. Spectating uses spectator mode with the camera bound to a participant, V cycles the view, and leaving puts you back where you were.
pvpocket.rule.c.mode.label: Combat mode
pvpocket.rule.c.mode.hint: Legacy mode removes the attack cooldown and applies 1.8 rules to blocking, knockback and armour.
pvpocket.rule.c.modeConflict.label: Mode conflict
pvpocket.rule.c.modeConflict.hint: The combat mode needs everyone's consent; the side that proposes cannot decide it alone.
pvpocket.rule.c.maxHealth.label: Max health
pvpocket.rule.c.maxHealth.hint: Health cap for everyone once inside. Vanilla is 20.
pvpocket.rule.c.naturalRegen.label: Natural regeneration
pvpocket.rule.c.naturalRegen.hint: When off, only potions and golden apples restore health.
pvpocket.rule.c.hunger.label: Hunger
pvpocket.rule.c.hunger.hint: When off, hunger never drops and starvation never hurts.
pvpocket.rule.c.fallDamage.label: Fall damage
pvpocket.rule.c.fallDamage.hint: When off, landing from a height does no damage.
pvpocket.rule.c.knockbackResistance.hint: Knockback resistance applied equally to every participant.
pvpocket.rule.d.loadoutScope.label: Loadout scope
pvpocket.rule.d.loadoutScope.hint: When set to per team, everyone on a side uses the same loadout.
pvpocket.rule.d.allowSwapBetweenRounds.h: When on, the loadout can be changed before every round.
pvpocket.rule.d.allowPickup.label: Pick up dropped items
pvpocket.rule.d.allowPickup.hint: When off, items dropped in the arena cannot be picked up.
pvpocket.rule.d.allowCrafting.label: Allow crafting
pvpocket.rule.d.allowCrafting.hint: When off, crafting tables and the inventory grid are disabled.
pvpocket.rule.d.allowConsumables.label: Allow consumables
pvpocket.rule.d.allowConsumables.hint: When off, potions, food and golden apples cannot be used.
pvpocket.rule.e.sizeX.label: Arena length (X)
pvpocket.rule.e.sizeX.hint: Plot size along X. Taken over by the map's own size once one is picked.
pvpocket.rule.e.sizeZ.label: Arena width (Z)
pvpocket.rule.e.sizeZ.hint: Plot size along Z. Taken over by the map's own size once one is picked.
pvpocket.rule.e.sizeY.label: Arena height (Y)
pvpocket.rule.e.sizeY.hint: Plot size along Y, which is how much vertical room there is to build in. Taken over by the map's own size once one is picked.
pvpocket.rule.e.template.label: Arena map
pvpocket.rule.e.template.hint: Flat is a floating platform whose size is the length and width below; the rest are built-in maps, and picking one makes the plot follow the map's bounding box. Every arena floats in the void, so leaving the plot means falling into it. A map can only host one duel at a time; maps in use are marked and skipped.
pvpocket.rule.e.boundary.label: Boundary rule
pvpocket.rule.e.boundary.hint: Push back: stepping out puts you back at the nearest point inside. Forfeit: stepping out starts a five-second countdown, and still being outside when it ends loses the round. A translucent curtain marks all four edges (blue = push back, red = forfeit); you can walk through it, it grows with your height, and only the stretch near you is drawn. Maps with an inner pit (the colosseum) ring the fighting floor only, not the seating.
pvpocket.rule.e.timeOfDay.label: Time of day
pvpocket.rule.e.timeOfDay.hint: A fixed time freezes the clock and switches the daylight cycle off; Natural keeps the vanilla cycle.
pvpocket.rule.e.weather.label: Weather
pvpocket.rule.e.weather.hint: Set at the start of every round. Weather is a dimension-wide property, so with several duels running at once the last one to start wins.
pvpocket.rule.e.hazard.label: Environmental hazards
pvpocket.rule.e.hazard.hint: Extra sources of damage that apply inside the arena.
pvpocket.rule.f.allowPlace.label: Allow placing blocks
pvpocket.rule.f.allowPlace.hint: When on, whitelisted blocks can be placed inside the arena.
pvpocket.rule.f.protectTerrain.label: Terrain protection
pvpocket.rule.f.protectTerrain.hint: When on, the map's own blocks cannot be broken and only blocks placed this round can be removed. When off the plot can be dug through, and the terrain is still restored when the round ends.
pvpocket.rule.f.allowBreakOwn.label: Allow breaking your own blocks
pvpocket.rule.f.allowBreakOwn.hint: Applies only to blocks placed during this duel; whether the map itself can be broken is up to Terrain protection.
pvpocket.rule.f.blockFilter.label: Block restrictions
pvpocket.rule.f.blockFilter.hint: Selected entries are banned. Beds, respawn anchors, TNT and fluid buckets are banned by default.
pvpocket.rule.f.allowExplosives.label: Allow explosives
pvpocket.rule.f.allowExplosives.hint: When off, TNT, creepers and end crystals produce no explosion.
pvpocket.rule.g.enderPearl.label: Allow ender pearls
pvpocket.rule.g.enderPearl.hint: When off, ender pearls cannot be thrown.
pvpocket.rule.g.allowSurrender.label: Allow surrender
pvpocket.rule.g.allowSurrender.hint: When off, a round can only end by a kill or by the clock.
pvpocket.rule.g.showOpponentHealth.label: Show opponent health
pvpocket.rule.g.showOpponentHealth.hint: Show the opponent's health at the top of the screen.
pvpocket.rule.g.chatScope.label: Chat during the duel
pvpocket.rule.g.chatScope.hint: Restricts who can see chat during the match.
pvpocket.rule.lo.count.label: Count
pvpocket.rule.lo.count.hint: How many go in this slot.
pvpocket.rule.lo.material.label: Material
pvpocket.rule.lo.material.hint: Changes only the look and the item name — not damage, durability or any other number.
pvpocket.rule.lo.damage.label: Attack damage
pvpocket.rule.lo.damage.hint: A bare fist is 1.0. This is the total, not a bonus.
pvpocket.rule.lo.armor.label: Armour
pvpocket.rule.lo.armor.hint: Each point reduces damage on the 1.8 curve; 20 points is a vanilla diamond set.
pvpocket.rule.lo.durability.label: Durability
pvpocket.rule.lo.durability.hint: 0 keeps the vanilla durability. Overridden by Unbreakable.
pvpocket.rule.lo.unbreakable.label: Unbreakable
pvpocket.rule.lo.unbreakable.hint: When on, the weapon never wears out and the durability field stops applying.
pvpocket.rule.lo.knockback.label: Knockback level
pvpocket.rule.lo.knockback.hint: Matches the vanilla Knockback level; each level adds half a block of push.
pvpocket.rule.lo.arrows.label: Arrows
pvpocket.rule.lo.arrows.hint: Only applies without Infinity. This many arrows are handed out on entry.
pvpocket.rule.lo.effect.label: Potion effect
pvpocket.rule.lo.effect.hint: All of them are splash potions and affect everyone in range where they land.
pvpocket.rule.lo.duration.label: Duration
pvpocket.rule.lo.amplifier.label: Effect level
pvpocket.rule.lo.amplifier.hint: I is the vanilla strength; each level adds one more.
pvpocket.rule.lo.food.label: Food
pvpocket.rule.lo.food.hint: Only the listed foods, so a loadout cannot hand out something exotic.
pvpocket.rule.lo.block.label: Block
pvpocket.rule.lo.block.hint: Wool (team-coloured) turns red or blue depending on your side.
pvpocket.flag.sweeping.hint: A sweep hits the enemies around your target. Swords only.
pvpocket.flag.infinity.hint: Arrows are not consumed. When off, an arrow count has to be set.
pvpocket.flag.flame.hint: Arrows set the target on fire.
pvpocket.flag.riptide.hint: Propels you in rain or water. Unusable on an arena with no water.
pvpocket.flag.piercing.hint: Crossbow bolts pass through several targets.
pvpocket.loadout.problem.too_many: A loadout holds at most %s items; this one has %s.
pvpocket.loadout.problem.durability: %sdurability must be between 0 and %s (-1 means unbreakable).
pvpocket.loadout.problem.arrows: %sthe arrow count must be between 0 and %s.
pvpocket.loadout.problem.effect_unknown: %sthis potion effect is not on the allowed list.
pvpocket.loadout.problem.duration: %sthe duration must be between %s and %s seconds.
pvpocket.loadout.problem.amplifier: %sthe effect level is out of range.
pvpocket.loadout.problem.food_unknown: %sthis food is not on the allowed list.
pvpocket.loadout.problem.block_unknown: %sthis block is not on the allowed list.
pvpocket.gui.rule.title: Duel rules
pvpocket.gui.rule.footer.reviewer: Accepting starts the duel with these rules
pvpocket.gui.rule.footer.proposer: Send it to your opponent when done
pvpocket.gui.rule.map_busy_tooltip: This arena is in use by another duel; pick a different map
pvpocket.gui.loadout.title: Loadout
pvpocket.gui.loadout.note.hint: Pick a category, then click an item to add it
pvpocket.gui.loadout.tooltip.row: Click to edit its attributes; the × removes it
pvpocket.gui.loadout.empty.title: No item selected
pvpocket.gui.loadout.empty.hint: Click an item on the left to edit it
pvpocket.gui.match.title: Matches
pvpocket.gui.match.keys: V cycles the camera · G detaches
pvpocket.gui.match.tooltip.leave: Stop watching and go back to where you were.
pvpocket.gui.match.tooltip.disabled: Spectating is off for this duel.
pvpocket.gui.match.tooltip.watch: Enter as a spectator; V cycles the camera.
pvpocket.command.help.duel: start a duel and open the rule panel
pvpocket.command.help.review: reopen the rule panel (use this after closing it)
pvpocket.command.help.arena_reset: end every duel and rebuild the whole arena dimension (operator only)
pvpocket.command.help.guard: toggle automatic removal from the arena dimension (operator only, per player)
pvpocket.command.help.list: open the match panel and join a duel that allows spectating
pvpocket.command.help.spectate: spectate directly by session id prefix, without the panel
pvpocket.command.help.loadout: show the loadout; edit opens the editor (no duel needed); give puts it in your hands; reset clears the personal loadout
pvpocket.command.help.footer: Rules and loadouts: proposing, accepting and rejecting all happen in the panel; the commands no longer offer those three.
pvpocket.command.arena.empty: No plots stamped yet (the server is still warming up, or the arena world is not loaded).
pvpocket.command.arena.rebuilding: The arena is being rebuilt; wait for this pass to finish.
pvpocket.command.arena.reset_done: Arena reset: %s duels were ended and the maps are being rebuilt.
pvpocket.command.session_not_ready: The session manager is not ready yet.
pvpocket.command.guard.players_only: This command records state per player and only works in game.
pvpocket.command.guard.on: Automatic removal on: standing in the arena dimension without a duel sends you back to where you came from after 5 seconds.
pvpocket.command.guard.off: Automatic removal off: you may stay in the arena dimension. Run /pvpocket guard true to restore it.
pvpocket.command.spectate.list: open the match panel and press Watch
pvpocket.command.spectate.key_hint: Press V while spectating to cycle the camera.
